newsitem.title: UK: Swiss Re starts as Salomon buy.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re starts as Salomon buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers on Monday initiated coverage of Swiss Reinsurance Co with a buy recommendation on the strength of future profit potential.
"Swiss Re's step-change in earnings over the past two years and cultural renaissance under new management are now well understood by the market," Salomon insurance analyst Brian Shea said in a note.

"However, we believe the market does not accurately discount the profitable business expansion for which Swiss Re has positioned itself...We expect earnings to grow at an annual 18 percent over the next three years."
Salomon expects both the recent acquisition of M&G Re from Prudential Corp PRU L and other organic growth opportunities will enhance Swiss Re's earnings.
"We believe shares' current valuation is still too low...We initiate coverage with a buy recommendation and a 12-month price target of 1,650 Swiss francs."

The shares were trading up five at 1,302 francs at 1418 GMT. They have risen 140 percent in the last two years, but their performance against the Swiss market has been disappointing this year. Salomon forecasts 24 percent growth in earnings this year, adding that the Swiss reinsurer compares favourably with its peers, Muenchener Rueck MUVG.F and General Re GRN.N.
"Swiss Re has the most diversified business mix of its peers, achieves comparable operating results and maintains a quality balance sheet," Shea said.
